_meta.description: Trigger Claude.ai data export. Settings are a hash-addressed modal as of ~2026-07: open a NEW tab directly on claude.ai/new#settings/data-privacy-controls and wait_for the dialog — the modal renders seconds AFTER tab 'complete' on a cold SPA load, so fixed delays race it (that raced-delay bug is why the 07-02/07-03 nightly runs failed with 'Text not found'). A mid-chain hashchange (navigate on an already-open tab) is NOT reliable — claude.ai's router only honors #settings at page load. Click 'Export data', then 'Export' in the confirm sub-dialog. FLOW CHANGE ~2026-07: the export is no longer a direct browser download — Anthropic emails a download link to the account email (expires in 24h).
flowChangeLog: 2026-07-03: old flow (navigate claude.ai/settings -> click Export data -> direct zip download) is dead. claude.ai/settings now redirects to the most recent chat. Rebuilt around the #settings hash modal. Export now emails a link instead of downloading directly. Verified live 2026-07-03 by Dee.
humanSteps: Anthropic emails a download link to the claude.ai account email (mw@mike-wolf.com). Link expires in 24 hours.
Click the link; the zip lands in ~/Downloads. The next nightly run (or acquire_exports) imports it — no manual move needed if it matches conversations*.zip / contains conversations.json.

chain.note: New tab, hash in the load URL — NEVER 'navigate' as the first step: with tabId null the runner hijacks Mike's active tab (that's what the 07-01..07-03 version did)
Settings modal renders seconds after tab 'complete' on a cold SPA load — poll, don't fixed-delay
Let the Privacy pane content settle inside the dialog
Opens the export confirm sub-dialog (range: All/30/90/Custom, defaults to All)
Confirm. On success the sub-dialog closes back to the Privacy pane and Anthropic queues the email
Capture post-click state. Success signature: dialog text is back to the Privacy pane (contains 'Your data' / 'Export data' but not 'download link will be sent')
